lines.text: AMC ten challenge! Think it's thirty-six? Nope!

lines.text: Two walls meet at a right angle. A two-piece fence, total length twelve, joins them.
lines.caption: Two walls meet at a right angle. A two-piece fence, total length 12, joins them.

lines.text: What's the largest area they can enclose?

lines.text: Treat each wall like a mirror.

lines.text: Reflect twice: an octagon, with perimeter forty-eight!
lines.caption: Reflect twice: an octagon, with perimeter 48!

lines.text: The regular one holds the most. Each side is forty-eight over eight, six.

lines.text: Our fence is exactly two of those sides!

lines.text: Our region is a quarter of it: eighteen plus eighteen root two!
